summary: Virgin Galactic filed an 8-K to announce a partial redemption of up to $10M of its 9.80% First Lien Notes due 2028, payable in common stock through a VWAP-based mechanism with a floor price. The redemption reduces a mandatory $30.4M redemption due by September 2026. This is a routine capital management action to cut cash interest, not a special situation. Management cites cash preservation as the rationale ahead of commercial operations in Q4 2026. No risk-arb angle exists as no M&A or activist campaign is involved; the filing is an ordinary liability management step.
